body:
The reason why it shouldn't be different is that:
- The duplication may fail if the extension is unrecognized by ResourceSaver.
- The file may become invisible if the extension is not included in text file extensions.

If the extension is valid, the file will be duplicated and correctly displayed, and converted if necessary. It's just an option for advanced users. The warning could clarify that, but I didn't want to make it too long.
